In case $C=\mathbb{P}^{1}$, Lemma 3.3 has a much easier proof. Namely, we have $\mathrm{Bun}_{T}^{0}=\mathrm{Spec}(\mathbb{F})/T$, so that the morphism $\{\mathcal{F}^{0}\}\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$ is smooth. Hence $f$ is smooth as well, which implies that $\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{U}}\cong f^{*}\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{B}}[-(g-1)\dim(T)]$ by standard properties of smooth pullback functors.

4. Zastava stacks and schemes

We continue with our smooth projective curve $C$ over $\mathbb{F}$.

4.1. Definition

Let $\mu\in\mathbf{Y}_{\succeq 0}$. We consider the stack $\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}$ which sends a scheme $S$ to the groupoid whose objects are the following data:

•

a point $E\in C^{\mu}(S)$ (see §2.4);

•

a $T$ -torsor $\mathcal{F}$ on $C\times S$;

•

a $G$ -torsor $\mathcal{E}$ on $C\times S$;

•

an isomorphism $\beta$ between the restrictions of $\mathcal{E}$ and $\mathcal{F}\times^{T}G$ to $(C\times S)\smallsetminus E$

which satisfy the following condition. Consider for $\xi\in\mathbf{X}_{+}$ the following commutative diagram:

(4.1)

${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces((\mathcal{F}(-E))_{\mathbb{F}_{T}(\xi)})_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces(\mathcal{F}_{\mathbb{F}_{T}(\xi)})_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces(\mathcal{E}_{\mathsf{M}(\xi)})_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces(\mathcal{F}_{\mathbb{F}_{T}(\xi)})_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces(\mathcal{F}_{\mathbb{F}_{T}(\xi)})_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces(\mathcal{F}_{\mathsf{M}(\xi)})_{|(C\times S)\smallsetminus E}}$ (2.10)(2.11) $\scriptstyle{\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\wr}$ (2.2) $\scriptstyle{\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\beta}$ $\scriptstyle{\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\wr}$ (2.3)

Then we require that the top face of this diagram admit (for any $\xi\in\mathbf{X}_{+}$ ) an extension to a diagram of sheaves

${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces(\mathcal{F}(-E))_{\mathbb{F}_{T}(\xi)}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\mathcal{F}_{\mathbb{F}_{T}(\xi)}}$ ${\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\mathcal{E}_{\mathsf{M}(\xi)}}$ (2.10) $\scriptstyle{\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\kappa_{\xi}}$ $\scriptstyle{\lx@inpgf@ignorespaces\tau_{\xi}}$

in which $\tau_{\xi}$ is a surjective map of vector bundles.

By construction there is a natural morphism of stacks

(4.2)

$\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}\to C^{\mu}\times\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$

sending $(E,\mathcal{F},\mathcal{E},\beta)$ to $(E,\mathcal{F})$. This map has a canonical section

$s^{\mu}:C^{\mu}\times\mathrm{Bun}_{T}\to\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}$

sending a pair $(E,\mathcal{F})$ to the data $(E,\mathcal{F},\mathcal{F}\times^{T}G,\mathrm{id})$.

We will denote by

$p_{1}:\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$

the composition of (4.2) with projection on $\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$. There is another morphism

$p_{2}:\mathbf{Z}^{\mu}\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T},$

sending $(E,\mathcal{F},\mathcal{E},\beta)$ to $\mathcal{F}(-E)$. (In other words, $p_{2}$ is the composition of (4.2) with the morphism $C^{\mu}\times\mathrm{Bun}_{T}\to\mathrm{Bun}_{T}$ defined by $(E,\mathcal{F})\mapsto\mathcal{F}(-E)$.)

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
